title: psyllium webbii
intro: Psyllium webbii, commonly known as Indian plantago, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is known for its high fiber content, which provides numerous health benefits, including promoting digestive regularity, lowering cholesterol levels, and aiding in blood sugar control. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium webbii include soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, making it useful for treating gastrointestinal issues such as constipation and diarrhea. The bioactive constituents of Psyllium webbii include mucilages, which are complex carbohydrates that contribute to its therapeutic effects, as well as other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant properties.
